# Seravolve

> Clean, science-backed skincare and dermatologist-crafted routines tailored for Indian skin types.

Seravolve is an Indian clinical skincare brand dedicated to simplicity, ingredient transparency, and barrier restoration. Formulated without parabens, sulfates, synthetic fragrances, or harsh toxins, every Seravolve product is 100% vegan, cruelty-free, and calibrated with clinically validated actives at effective, non-irritating concentrations.

## Individual Formulations (5 Core Products)
- [2% Salicylic Acid Facewash](https://seravolve.com/products/salicylic-acid-facewash): Clarifying daily gel cleanser with 2% BHA (Salicylic Acid) to unclog pores, eliminate excess sebum, and prevent acne breakouts without stripping moisture.
- [3% Niacinamide & Rice Water Toner](https://seravolve.com/products/niacinamide-rice-water-toner): Hydrating, alcohol-free toner infused with 3% Niacinamide and fermented rice water to tighten pores, regulate oil production, and restore the skin's natural pH.
- [10% Vitamin C Face Serum](https://seravolve.com/products/vitamin-c-face-serum): Potent brightening antioxidant serum featuring 10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid to fade hyperpigmentation, brighten dark spots, and stimulate collagen synthesis.
- [Barrier Repair Moisturiser](https://seravolve.com/products/blue-moisturiser): Lightweight, ceramide-infused cream designed to lock in hydration, soothe redness, and repair compromised lipid barriers in all climates.
- [Ultra-Light Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50+](https://seravolve.com/products/sunscreen-fluid-spf): Broad-spectrum UVA/UVB PA++++ physical/hybrid sunscreen with a weightless, invisible finish and zero white cast, optimized for humid weather.

## Curated Skincare Routines (6 Targeted Regimens)
- [Full Seravolve Routine (5-Step Kit)](https://seravolve.com/products/full-seravolve-routine): Complete morning and evening regimen encompassing Cleanse, Tone, Treat, Moisturize, and Protect for optimal long-term skin health.
- [Acne Control Routine (3-Step Kit)](https://seravolve.com/products/acne-control-routine): Targeted 3-step routine (Salicylic Facewash + Niacinamide Toner + Barrier Moisturiser) to soothe active acne, minimize pores, and control shine.
- [Skin Brightening Routine (3-Step Kit)](https://seravolve.com/products/skin-brightening-routine): Radiance-boosting system (Facewash + 10% Vitamin C Serum + Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50+) to clear dullness and even out sun-induced pigmentation.
- [Barrier Repair and Hydration Routine (3-Step Kit)](https://seravolve.com/products/barrier-repair-and-hydration-routine): Calming regimen (Gentle Cleanser + Hydrating Rice Toner + Barrier Moisturiser) designed for dry, sensitive, or damaged skin barriers.
- [Smooth Skin Routine (2-Step Kit)](https://seravolve.com/products/smooth-skin-routine): Fast 2-step exfoliation and hydration duo (Facewash + Moisturiser) for rough, textured skin.
- [Daily UV Defence Routine (2-Step Kit)](https://seravolve.com/products/daily-uv-defence-routine): Minimalist day kit (Moisturiser + SPF 50+ Sunscreen Fluid) providing moisture barrier protection and blue-light/UV defense.
